disposition.rationale: Scoped brain power accounting constrains the energy thesis but is not an AI-system performance hypothesis.
The published sparse-coding result is representation-learning evidence rather than a new project mechanism.
The published early-exit result is an engineering baseline; shifted calibration and tail risk are separate hypotheses.
Confirming the scoped visual-cortex model requires reproducing its source-domain response study, not running an AI-system protocol.
The I-JEPA result supplies objective-design evidence without asserting multimodal or causal grounding.
Elastic Weight Consolidation is an established continual-learning baseline, not the proposed memory architecture.
This disputed universal is retained as a constraint against treating grokking as a maturity or pruning certificate.
The lottery-ticket result is a pruning baseline scoped to its published settings.
The RAG result is an established retrieval baseline; provenance and conflict handling are separate project consequences.
Loihi's published substrate capabilities are hardware evidence, not proof of superiority on project tasks.
The disputed estimate is retained as a warning against undefined operation equivalence, not as a hypothesis an AI run can rescue.
Branch-local dendritic integration motivates compartment abstractions without claiming they outperform artificial baselines.
Delayed dopamine-gated plasticity motivates eligibility traces but does not validate an artificial three-factor rule.
Active-whisker mechanics motivates controlled-observability experiments but is not itself an AI active-sensing claim.
Octopus peripheral control is biological motivation for local-versus-central controls, not a universal controller hypothesis.
The fly sparsification result links circuit activity to discrimination without asserting an artificial few-shot advantage.
Arabidopsis stress memory is scoped evidence for reversible priming rather than an AI-memory design claim.
Affinity maturation motivates bounded explore-select-protect loops without validating artificial mutation and selection.
The embodied-simulation result is source evidence for morphology-controller co-design, not physical or disembodied transfer.
Ant trail geometry motivates externalized coordination state without asserting a digital stigmergy advantage.
Bacterial bet hedging motivates diversity under unpredictable regimes but does not claim arbitrary AI noise is useful.
Planarian polarity-guided repair motivates target-state constraints without establishing an artificial reconstruction method.
Assembly-specific replay disruption is causal neuroscience evidence, not proof of an artificial replay policy.
The selective-replay studies motivate nonuniform allocation while explicitly failing to identify one universal priority signal.
Schema-sensitive consolidation is a scoped animal result, not authorization for rapid writes into artificial slow memory.
Retrieval-sensitive reconsolidation motivates versioned write windows without specifying an AI update rule.
The disputed prediction-error gate for human fear-memory destabilization requires source-domain replication, not an AI memory test.
Regulated forgetting in flies motivates memory lifecycle controls without asserting an artificial forgetting benefit.
Microglial structural refinement motivates a maintenance actor but does not establish an artificial pruning rule.
Extracellular-matrix removal is evidence that mature plasticity constraints can reopen, not that subsequent artificial change is useful.
The Lynx1 result motivates receiver-local plasticity gates without making an artificial module-gating performance claim.
Use-coupled presynaptic ATP supply motivates local resource backpressure but is not a scheduler result.
Mitochondrial placement and mobility motivate migration accounting without determining artificial compute placement.
Pericyte-mediated local supply response motivates an adjacent resource plane but does not validate an artificial controller.

The fish and model result motivates abstention-aware aggregation while robust aggregation remains the engineering null.
Causal leader-follower influence inferred from pigeon telemetry requires source-domain intervention or replication.
